source: 8.0.0 runs each RegexStringMatcher regex in MatchingTimeoutExecutor; java.util.regex backtracking on a catastrophic pattern (path `/(.*a){25}` vs a 40-character path) passes regexMatchingTimeoutMillis (a startup property, here 300), so a WARN `regex evaluation timed out after {}ms for pattern:{}— treating as non-match` is written in the scan, before the expectation's not-matched entry, and again in the closest expectation's re-evaluation, and the request does not match. A short input fails within the budget and logs no timeout; a normal regex still matches.

steps.note: Java backtracking passes the 300 ms budget: no match
on a short path the same pattern fails within the budget: no timeout entry
